Mumbai birthday party leads to police case after airgun firing

A birthday celebration in Mumbai's Gorai and Borivali areas resulted in a police case against 10 individuals, including a 26-year-old man. The incident involved firing a baby airgun on a public road, which was reportedly filmed and shared on social media. Police have booked the individuals involved following the incident.
